pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: A projectile-tagged hit triggers teleportation and is rejected while the enemy is awake. Normal damage is also rejected during teleportation and sleep.

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Reacquire its new position before continuing a melee sequence.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Enderitium Gem, Eye Crystal. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
